CMB lensing visualizer

Joann Jones
joannjones@uchicago.edu
github.com/joannjones415

Gravitational lensing by intervening large–scale structure remaps the CMB temperature field. It smooths the acoustic peaks and transfers power into the damping tail, with the deflection sourced by the lensing potential CLφφ. Here that potential is deformed independently of the cosmology that generated it, so the lensing and the primary anisotropies can be varied separately. Two parameterizations are available: a single amplitude AL rescaling every L equally, or the first two lensing principal components θ1,θ2, which carry most of the peak–smoothing information and deform CLφφ with a shape rather than a constant. The cosmological sliders move the primary spectrum and the lensing potential together.

ℒ is the lensing operation — it takes an unlensed spectrum and a lensing potential and returns the lensed spectrum; p are the cosmological parameters.
